item.title: Hyundai Power Transformers breaks ground on its newest expansion
item.description: Hyundai Power Transformers USA, a long-time manufacturer in Montgomery, is growing its operation even more. The company is breaking ground on their newest $200 million expansion, bringing 200 jobs to the Capital City. Before the shovels hit the dirt, guests at the event heard remarks from both company executives and city and state leaders, including Alabama Governor Kay Ivey, U.S....

item.title: Auto supplier announces $37 million expansion at Auburn facility
item.description: Shinhwa Auto USA has announced a $37 million expansion and will add jobs to bring advanced tooling capabilities and vertical integration to its plant in Auburn.

item.title: Thunderbirds fall in state title game
item.description: The Park Crossing Thunderbirds fall to Hazel Green 67-47 in the first 6A Girls State Championship.

item.title: Pedestrian killed in Montgomery collision
item.description: A man has died after being hit by a car in Montgomery.

item.title: President Trump grieves with families during return of soldiers killed in Middle East conflict
item.description: The dignified transfer, a ritual that returns the remains of U.S. service members killed in action, is considered one of the most somber duties of any commander in chief.

item.title: No. 16 Alabama beats Auburn 96-84 as Philon, Holloway each score 21 points
item.description: Alabama's Labaron Philon and Aden Holloway each scored 21 points as No. 16 Alabama beat Auburn 96-84 in the regular-season finale for both teams.

item.title: 61 years after Bloody Sunday in Selma led to the Voting Rights Act of 1965, some worry about future
item.description: Sixty-one years after state troopers attacked Civil Rights marchers on the Edmund Pettus Bridge, thousands are gathering in Selma this weekend, with some having concerns about the future of the Voting Rights Act.

item.title: Selma police investigating two shootings that left eight people injured
item.description: Selma police are investigating two separate shootings that left a total of eight people injured.

item.title: Hundreds attend the 32nd annual Culinary Caper Celebration Sunday
item.description: "Meals On Wheels Montgomery" hosts their annual Culinary Caper Celebration to raise money for their programs to be able to continue serving seniors in the Montgomery area.

item.title: Both Trojan Teams set to play in the Sun Belt Title Game
item.description: Both the Troy men's and women's basketball teams will play in the Sun Belt Championship games. The women's team will face James Madison, while the men's team will face Georgia Southern.
